title: Yellowed Crunchy Venezuelan Peanut Empanadas
description: A weeknight Venezuelan dish featuring peanuts in a crunchy empanada, served on a hot stone plate. This keto-friendly empanada has a bitter and juicy flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the almond flour, coconut oil, eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the roasted peanuts, granulated sweetener, and water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of peanut filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a hot stone plate and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve the empanadas hot and enjoy.
